title: Pagewell
features: Ebook library (ebooks + audiobooks) with EPUB reading support: chapters, adjustable text size, theme, reading progress
Audiobook streaming and playback: play/pause, 15s skip, speed, chapter list, sleep timer, buffering indicator
Searchable content and reference library: full-text search across books, articles and reference entries with filters
Daily editorial content: a daily featured article and reading picks on the Today screen
User accounts: sign in / create account, profile with reading stats
Bookmarks and favourites: bookmark a page or audio position, favourite a book
Free and premium membership: premium badge on locked titles, paywall with monthly/annual plans
Content management for ongoing updates: an editor studio that schedules and publishes daily content (simulated CMS feed)

bottomTabBar.note: Flat white bar, 1px top border, 5 tabs in this exact order. Active tab: icon + label in accentFill #A337BA with a small accentTint pill behind the icon; inactive: text.secondary.

sharedComponents.statusBar: Top header row: screen title left in the display serif, small round avatar right.
sharedComponents.controls: Primary button: pill, 56px, accentFill with white label. Secondary: pill, white with 1.5px borderStrong border, ink label. Input: 12px radius, 52px, white, borderStrong border, focus 2px accentFill ring. Card: white, 20px radius, soft shadow. Chip: pill 32px, accentTint fill, accentFill 13px label. Book cover: 2:3 ratio, 12px radius, soft shadow. Premium badge: small pill, ink fill, white 12px 'Premium' label with crown icon. Mini player: white card pinned above the tab bar with cover, title, play button.
